subject.title: Cron "New Job" form misaligns the Description field after interacting with Agent ID

question: Which checked-in route, repository, or build owns the Cron New Job editor described here, and should this ClawHub issue remain the tracking item for that UI bug?
rationale: Current main and v0.23.1 do not contain the reported form, so automation cannot decide whether to fix ClawHub dashboard code, route the report elsewhere, or wait for future cron-template product work.

options.title: Identify the owning UI surface
options.body: Ask for or locate the real route/branch, then fix the grid alignment in that owning UI with browser proof.

options.title: Treat it as future cron-template work
options.body: If the report refers to a not-yet-shipped cron-template UI, keep the product tracking in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/86 and leave this bug blocked on a concrete reproduction path.

options.title: Route outside ClawHub
options.body: If the form lives only in another OpenClaw repository, branch, or private demo workspace, preserve the context here and move the actionable fix to that owner.

recommendation.title: Identify the owning UI surface
recommendation.body: Ask for or locate the real route/branch, then fix the grid alignment in that owning UI with browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is tied to the dashboard merge, v0.23.1 baseline, and product-scope guardrails that determine whether this belongs in ClawHub.
